angebote.titel: Internship with Orphaned Rhino and Cheetah Conservation in South Africa
angebote.beschreibung: We are looking for 4-6 interns that want to gain hands-on experience working at a South African wildlife sanctuary with a wide variety of endangered species and other exotic wildlife such as rhinos, cheetahs, hippos, lions, hyenas, leopards.  Some of these animals will be rehabilitated and released into the wild while others are long term residents.  Be a part of important conservation efforts while gaining confidence with animal care.  Appreciate the importance of human-wildlife conflict, anti-poaching, and community involvement in maintaining healthy populations of these iconic animals.   Ha
